reconstruction.scope: Balmoral Castle: full connected mapped castle and five height-tagged integral parts, open rear courtyard, pale granite main residence with slate roof ranges and stepped gables, conical/bartizan turrets, south arched entrance porch, small green-roofed southeast turret and tall clock tower with corner cones and round crown. Keep the separate estate offices/outbuildings, gardens, walls, fountain and all unrelated buildings as context.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Map heights5/8/11/17/23m are unqualified working body controls. Photo-led main slate ridges rise4.6m above11m eaves; tower corner cones reach about29m, circular crown27m and flagstaff32m. Lower rear wings use a reconstructed6.5m body and3m roof rise. Turret diameters, crow steps, openings, roof sections and unseen north/east details are approximations, not a measured survey. The clock is a static schematic face; no copied lettering, royal flag artwork or furnished interiors.
